playbook.intent: Company objectives are set and published, yet an individual engineer still cannot say which one the ticket in front of them serves. It is done when each person's commitments were tied to a team key result in a one-to-one, twelve weekly confidence posts have accumulated by quarter end, and the retro scoring those results has already fed the next planning round.
playbook.scope: Company OKR -> team OKR -> personal OKR with weekly check-ins and a quarterly blameless retro. Output: every dev knows what their work ladders to

success-criteria.criterion: Every individual contributor holds commitments traceable to a team key result, agreed face to face in a one-to-one rather than assigned over email
Twelve consecutive weekly confidence posts per team exist by quarter end, and managers read them as a moving average instead of reacting to a single bad week
Any key result whose confidence stayed under 0.3 had its scope cut at mid-quarter, with the adjustment announced to the company in writing rather than quietly dropped
Final scores per key result cite the evidence behind them, and what the retro found is already in the input deck for the next planning round

stage.name: Cascade
stage.intent: Translate company OKRs to team and individual.

tasks.task: Team leads draft team OKRs aligned to company OKRs
Each IC drafts personal commitments aligned to team OKRs

stage.decision-gate: Advance only when every IC has commitments tied to a team OKR.

stage.name: Weekly OKR Check-In

tasks.task: Each team posts confidence (0.0-1.0) per KR weekly
Manager spots dropping confidence and unblocks
Track moving averages, not single weeks

stage.decision-gate: Advance only when 12 consecutive weekly posts exist by quarter end.

stage.name: Mid-Quarter Adjustment

tasks.task: Adjust scope where confidence is sustained <0.3

stage.decision-gate: Advance only when adjustments are written down.

stage.name: Quarter Retro

tasks.task: Final score per KR with evidence
Feed insights into next quarter's planning

stage.decision-gate: Required output: a published retro doc fed into next planning.
